about: The trip map replay's pace (Crewluve activity markers design §3.2, §4.1): a day in 96 s at 1x; a leg in motion that would take under 6 s slows to 6 s, and where legs overlap the slowest wins; with Quick layovers on, a wait of L seconds plays in min(L / 900, max(3, L / 86,400)) seconds, a second a day, never under 3 s and never slower than a day in 96 s; with it off, a day in 96 s. The speed multiplies everything. Each case plays from the span's start at its speed, and each check is the trip time `seconds` real seconds after pressing play. replayLength is the whole replay at 1x. waitLabels are the lengths the timeline writes on a wait's block: whole hours to the nearest under 48 h, whole days to the nearest from 48 h, none when it rounds to 0 h (halves round up). The app's TripReplayClockPaceTests and TripTimelineTests and the website's tests run every case. Change both copies together.

cases.name: Louisville, a day in Cologne, Dubai, 20 hours there, and home; Quick layovers on
cases.note: Legs at a day in 96 s (900 trip s a replay s): 8 h = 28,800 s / 900 = 32 s, 6 h = 24 s, 14 h = 56 s. Waits: 24 h takes min(86,400 / 900 = 96 s, max(3 s, 1 s a day x 1 day = 1 s)) = 3 s, so 28,800 trip s a replay s; 20 h takes min(80 s, max(3 s, 0.83 s)) = 3 s, so 24,000 trip s a replay s. Whole: 32 + 3 + 24 + 3 + 56 = 118 s. At 16 s: 16 x 900 = 4 h. At 33.5 s: 8 h + 1.5 x 28,800 s (12 h) = 20 h. At 35 s: 32 h. At 59 s: 32 h + 24 s x 900 = 38 h. At 60.5 s: 38 h + 1.5 x 24,000 s (10 h) = 48 h. At 118 s and after: the end, 72 h.

cases.name: The same trip with Quick layovers off
cases.note: Everything at a day in 96 s: 72 h = 259,200 s / 900 = 288 s. Legs 32 s, 24 s, 56 s; waits 24 h = 96 s and 20 h = 80 s. At 35 s: 8 h + 3 x 900 s (45 min) = 8 h 45 min. At 128 s: 32 + 96 = 32 h. At 152 s: 38 h. At 232 s: 152 + 80 = 58 h. At 288 s: 72 h.

cases.name: The same trip with Quick layovers on, at 10x
cases.note: The speed multiplies everything: each real second is 10 replay seconds at 1x (118 s in all, from the first case). At 2 s: 20 s, 5 h. At 3.25 s: 32.5 s, 8 h + 0.5 x 28,800 s (4 h) = 12 h. At 3.5 s: 35 s, 32 h. At 12 s and after: the end. Each check is a time exact in binary, as at 10x a second is 9,000 trip seconds.

cases.name: A four-day layover takes 4 s with Quick layovers on
cases.note: Legs: 2 h = 7,200 s / 900 = 8 s each. The wait: 96 h = 345,600 s takes min(345,600 / 900 = 384 s, max(3 s, 1 s a day x 4 days = 4 s)) = 4 s, so 86,400 trip s a replay s, a day a second. Whole: 8 + 4 + 8 = 20 s. At 9 s: 2 h + 1 day = 26 h. At 10 s: 50 h. At 12 s: 98 h. At 20 s: 100 h.

cases.name: The four-day layover with Quick layovers off takes 6 min 24 s
cases.note: Everything at a day in 96 s: the wait is 345,600 / 900 = 384 s (6 min 24 s); the legs 8 s each. Whole: 400 s. At 200 s: 2 h + 192 s x 900 = 2 h + 48 h = 50 h. At 392 s: 98 h. At 400 s: 100 h.

cases.name: A 1-hour turn and a 2-hour wait each take 3 s
cases.note: Legs: 2 h = 8 s each. The 1-hour turn: min(3,600 / 900 = 4 s, max(3 s, 0.04 s)) = 3 s, so 1,200 trip s a replay s. The 2-hour wait: min(8 s, max(3 s, 0.08 s)) = 3 s, so 7,200 / 3 = 2,400 trip s a replay s. Whole: 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 8 = 30 s. At 9 s: 2 h + 1 s x 1,200 = 2 h 20 min. At 11 s: 3 h. At 19 s: 5 h. At 20.5 s: 5 h + 1.5 x 2,400 s (1 h) = 6 h. At 22 s: 7 h. At 30 s: 9 h.

cases.name: Short legs still take 6 s, and waits under 45 minutes keep their pace with Quick layovers on
cases.note: A 25-min drive (1,500 s / 900 = 1.67 s) slows to 6 s, 250 trip s a replay s. The 30-min wait: min(2 s, max(3 s, 0.02 s)) = 2 s, its pace kept. A 50-min hop (3.33 s) slows to 6 s, 500 trip s a replay s. The 1-hour wait: min(4 s, 3 s) = 3 s. The 8-hour flight: 32 s. Whole: 6 + 2 + 6 + 3 + 32 = 49 s. At 3 s: 3 x 250 s = 12 min 30 s. At 6 s: 25 min. At 8 s: 55 min. At 14 s: 1 h 45 min. At 17 s: 2 h 45 min. At 49 s: 10 h 45 min.

cases.name: A drive to base, a night there, then the flight; Quick layovers on
cases.note: The 90-min drive: 5,400 / 900 = 6 s, already 6 s. The 12 h 30 min at base: min(45,000 / 900 = 50 s, max(3 s, 0.52 s)) = 3 s, so 15,000 trip s a replay s. The 8-hour flight: 32 s. Whole: 6 + 3 + 32 = 41 s. At 7.5 s: 1 h 30 min + 1.5 x 15,000 s (6 h 15 min) = 7 h 45 min. At 9 s: 14 h. At 41 s: 22 h.
